args: apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*     && groupadd --gid 1000 keycloak     && useradd --uid 1000 --gid 0 --home-dir /opt/keycloak --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin keycloak

mvn --strict-checksums -B -ntp verify     org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-dependency-plugin:3.11.0:copy-dependencies -DoutputDirectory=/cli-dependencies     && test "$(find /cli-dependencies -type f | wc -l)" -eq 25     && (cd /cli-dependencies && sha256sum --strict -c /cli-patch/cli-dependencies.sha256)     && mkdir /cli-proof     && javac --release 17 -cp target/keycloak-admin-cli-26.7.3.jar -d /cli-proof /cli-patch/CliJacksonProof.java     && java -Xmx256m -cp /cli-proof:target/keycloak-admin-cli-26.7.3.jar CliJacksonProof

mkdir /patch/classes     && javac --release 17 -proc:none -classpath '/vendor/boot/*:/vendor/main/*:/vendor/deployment/*'        -d /patch/classes /patch/QuarkusDescriptorOrderingPatch.java /patch/DescriptorOrderingProof.java     && java -classpath '/patch/classes:/vendor/boot/*:/vendor/main/*:/vendor/deployment/*' DescriptorOrderingProof baseline     && java -classpath '/patch/classes:/vendor/boot/*:/vendor/main/*:/vendor/deployment/*' QuarkusDescriptorOrderingPatch        /vendor/deployment/io.quarkus.quarkus-hibernate-orm-deployment-3.33.3.1.jar /patch/descriptor-ordering.jar     && java -classpath '/patch/classes:/patch/descriptor-ordering.jar:/vendor/boot/*:/vendor/main/*:/vendor/deployment/*' DescriptorOrderingProof patched
